title: COP Accounting Reversal Event
description: Event type for reversing or compensating a prior transaction. Reversal preserves the original trace while neutralizing its accounting effect.

reversal_id.description: Unique identifier for this reversal event.

reversal_type.description: Type of reversal. 'full' reverses entire original, 'partial' reverses portion, 'compensating' creates new opposite transaction.

partial_amount.description: For partial reversals, the amount being reversed.

reason.description: Reason for the reversal. Required for auditability.

compensating_postings.description: For compensating reversals, the new postings that compensate the original.

authorized_by.description: Reference to authority (mandate, policy, or person) authorizing this reversal.

evidence_references.description: Supporting evidence for the reversal (e.g., dispute notice, error log).

effective_at.description: When the reversal takes effect. Defaults to event timestamp.
